therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Partial agonist of nicotinic acetylcholine receptors to reduce nicotine craving and withdrawal symptoms
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Smoking cessation to reduce perioperative complications
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with newly diagnosed lung cancer who smoke cigarettes
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Surgical complications including mortality, re-hospitalization, pulmonary complications, ICU readmission, wound infection, and anastomotic failure

results.effect_size: Unable to assess - trial terminated early with insufficient enrollment
biomarker_changes: Salivary cotinine testing for smoking abstinence
safety_signals: General disorders and administration site conditions
results.dose_information: Varenicline given PO, specific dose not specified
